description: Manual metal arc welding, oxy-fuel flame cutting, joint edge beveling, and metal fabrication of structural steel sections, gates, window grills, trusses, and containers.
daily_tasks: Beveling and cleaning metal joint edges with 4-inch angle grinders
Positioning structural members and clamping with magnetic squares
Depositing short tack welds (taka) to lock alignment
Striking arc and depositing stringer and weave weld beads with SMAW electrodes
Chipping slag between passes with chipping hammer and wire brush
Cutting steel plates and channels with oxy-acetylene torch
Grinding structural weld seams flush for clean painted surfaces
advanced_tasks: Vertical-up (3G) and overhead (4G) position structural groove welding
Welding high-stress structural pipe joints using E7018 low-hydrogen electrodes
Fabricating roof trusses with expansion joint clearances to minimize thermal distortion
Oxy-fuel flame preheating and flame gouging to remove cracked root passes
materials: AWS E6013 rutile mild steel electrodes (2.5, 3.15, 4.0 mm)
Mild steel hollow sections, angles, channels, sheets
work_processes: Metal Cutting -> Edge Beveling -> Fit-Up & Clamping -> Tack Welding -> Root Pass -> Slag Chipping -> Capping Pass -> Weld Dressing
troubleshooting_tasks: Adjusting welding amperage to eliminate electrode sticking or burn-through holes
Diagnosing and re-welding porosity holes caused by damp electrodes or surface oil
Balancing heat input to prevent thermal warping in thin sheet metal gates
Rectifying weld undercut along the joint toe by adjusting electrode travel angle
quality_inspection: Inspecting weld bead for uniform convex profile without excessive reinforcement
Checking joint edges for complete fusion and absence of cold lap or cracking
Verifying complete slag removal before depositing successive capping passes
Checking finished fabrication dimensions against layout blueprints
measurement_and_planning: Calculating metal thermal contraction allowance (approx 1.5mm per meter)
Marking cutting lines on steel channels with soapstone / carbide scriber
safety_practices: Mandatory shade 10 or 11 optical filter to prevent retinal arc-eye flash
Wearing heavy cowhide leather welding gloves and protective leather apron
Keeping fire extinguisher / water bucket nearby during hot cutting
Ensuring proper fume ventilation when welding in confined workshops
maintenance: Inspecting welding lead cable insulation for bare copper exposure
Tightening loose earth ground clamp bolts to prevent resistance heating
Replacing worn grinding wheel discs before peripheral cracking occurs
customer_communication: Advising on gauge thickness of steel hollow pipes for boundary gates
Providing weight-based (per kg) vs square-foot fabrication estimates
Recommending zinc-chromate anti-rust primer coating before delivery
canonical_skills: Shielded Metal Arc Welding with E6013 Electrodes
Weld Slag Removal and Bead Cleaning
